_comment: Run grid for the Tier-2 screening ensemble (plan S4/Tier 2).
Three conditions only: two neutron points spanning the temperature window
plus one ion point, so the dose-rate-sensitive parameters (L_hat, i_mobile)
are actually exercised.  All three sit inside the T0.4 envelope.
T_K is the ACTUAL temperature of the experiment.  The -60 C ion shift
(T_eq = T - 60) is a data-side plotting device (plan S3.2) and is exactly
collinear with an ion dummy; it must NEVER reach the simulator.  It is
absent from this file by construction and run_ensemble asserts on it.
G is the NRT displacement rate in dpa/s BEFORE the survival factor eta;
leave null to take the workbook value.  The ion point's higher dose rate is
physics the model is supposed to reproduce, not a correction to apply.

stopped.reason: raise timeout_s 16200 -> 28800 before the I1 block (measured 33% full dose at 16200; I1 median ~19-20ks sits just above that cap)

admissibility_rule.note: delta_FP is blind to SIA-axis truncation (the <100> pile-up held delta_FP at 1e-8 while 96% of content sat at n=I), so grid adequacy is judged by pile/occupancy. It is NOT blind to the VACANCY axis -- delta_FP rests on the swelling identity S = S_I + Delta J^d and S is the vacancy inventory. The vacancy axis was unchecked until 2026-08-02; at the check_machine probe (V=120) mean_n_v moved 18.7->136 and swelling 58x on going to V=240.
